s1.body: Usually {days} days of intensive instruction for the Postpartum Doula program, in person or online. Training fees vary by provider. Find an ADA course

s3.body: A {written}-minute written exam and a {practical}-minute one-on-one practical exam. Bring a valid government-issued photo ID. Exam day and ID

s4.body: By email in about {days} business days. The pass mark is {pass}/{max}. If you pass, ADA issues your certificate and lists you in the ADA registry, where anyone can check it. Check the registry
